recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future wording changes should be handled under a ServiceRequest-specific issue rather than reopening this applied STU3 ProcedureRequest correction.
issue_request: FHIR-13160 was Published with resolution Persuasive for STU3. It requested changing ProcedureRequest performer wording from diagnostic testing to requested procedure and reason wording from diagnostic investigation to procedure.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged STU3 application in commit 7c87cdc144040f83684cc75ff4c090163d148f62 changed ProcedureRequest occurrence, performerType, performer, reasonCode, and reasonReference descriptions away from diagnostic testing/investigation wording.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest was later renamed and broadened to ServiceRequest by FHIR-13867, which is already represented on the combined branch. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as an active OO resource and keeps ProcedureRequest only as a historical merged/renamed note. Later ServiceRequest scope work, including already-represented FHIR-50610, intentionally treats diagnostics as one supported ServiceRequest use case.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current ServiceRequest.performerType says the desired performer is for the requested service, and ServiceRequest.reason says it is the reason or indication for requesting the service with service-oriented comments. Remaining diagnostic investigation wording is contextual scope/example wording, not the stale DiagnosticRequest-only element text identified by the issue.
